findings.title: equals() overridden without hashCode()
findings.description: CellKey overrides equals() but not hashCode(), violating the Object contract: two equal keys hash to different buckets so HashMap/HashSet lookups with a new CellKey(x, y) fail; implement hashCode() with Objects.hash(x, y).
findings.suggestion: Add `@Override public int hashCode() { return Objects.hash(x, y); }`.
